//: THE REACH — the curated star map every shipped scenario is played on (GDD §19). Nine regions in three rings — the Core (commerce, the capital, order), the Middle (leaning whichever way it is pushed) and the Rim (lawless, restless, where houses break away) — of three or four systems each. Territory is DERIVED from the planet holding in each system; `baseline` names the minor-houses file merged into every scenario here so few worlds are empty — and the ones that are, on the Rim, are where the trouble starts. `capital` is the system whose holder keeps the court. `rings` tunes how each ring behaves. Positions are map units (~1280×780), laid out as rings.
name: The Reach

rings.//: prosperity: added to every holding's prosperity target. unrestDrift: added to populated worlds' unrest each turn. lawlessnessDrift/Start: raiders on the lanes (taxes ledgers, feeds risings). allegiance: where the region's loyalty to the capital settles (offset from 50). tradeBonus: credits per peopled world. charterBonus: extra charter per venture level to the world's holder.

regions.name: The Western Marches
regions.description: Frontier worlds at the edge of the lanes: hard soil, harder people, and houses that remember when no one ruled them.

regions.name: The Drake Lanes
regions.description: The trade spine of the Reach. Everything that moves, moves through here, and everyone who moves it wants a cut.

regions.name: The Greywater Reach
regions.description: Old blood. The counts and dukes of the Reach proper, their forges, their feuds, their long memories.

regions.name: The Imperial Core
regions.description: Aurelia Prime and the worlds that orbit its favour. Where the throne stands, or where it will.

regions.name: The Southern Spire
regions.description: Scholars, archivists and the belt-miners who feed them. Quiet, clever, and never as neutral as it claims.

regions.name: The Valmont Anvils
regions.description: Industry without apology. Hull-yards, refineries and kilns under a sky the colour of slag.

regions.name: The Golden Concourse
regions.description: The money-worlds of the Core. Banks older than titles, prices set by breakfast, and a bourse that has outlasted three thrones.

regions.name: The Lantern Shoals
regions.description: Lighthouse-worlds on the long lane south. Loyal when the Core is strong, forgetful when it is not.

regions.name: The Ashen Verge
regions.description: Ash plains, smugglers' harbours and a prison-world turned pirate haven. The law arrives here by fleet or not at all.

regions.name: The Pale Reaches
regions.description: Hard winters at the end of the lanes. Knightly houses that answer to no count, and the richest, loneliest belt in the Reach.

systems.name: Tessaly
systems.description: Grain terraces and a stubborn barony.

systems.name: The Anvil
systems.description: Foundries older than the houses that run them.

systems.name: The Veil
systems.description: A cold frontier relay; the last light before the dark.

systems.name: Drake Crossing
systems.description: The customs world of the Reach. Every lane pays here.

systems.name: Sato Holdfast
systems.description: A fortress on a rock, held by a knightly house for six generations.

systems.name: Highmarch
systems.description: Rich agri-terraces and a market that never sleeps.

systems.name: Greywater
systems.description: Harbour-world of the old counts.

systems.name: Anvil's Rest
systems.description: The great forge of the Reach, and the ducal seat beside it.

systems.name: Cinder Gate
systems.description: Bastion-world guarding the lane to the Core.

systems.name: Aurelia Prime
systems.description: The jewel. Marble, senates, and the shadow of a throne.

systems.name: Drydock Nine
systems.description: Orbital yards strung around a gas giant.

systems.name: Castrum
systems.description: The garrison world of the Core; its legions answer to whoever holds the Prime.

systems.name: The Spire
systems.description: The Academy's archive-world; tall, dry and proud.

systems.name: Lesser Marrow
systems.description: A modest colony with ambitions.

systems.name: Ember Shoal
systems.description: A mining belt lit by its own slag-fires.

systems.name: The Valmont Anvils
systems.description: Valmont's forges; the hulls of half the Reach were laid here.

systems.name: Ironhold
systems.description: Deep mines and the people who do not come up.

systems.name: The Kilns
systems.description: Refineries and kilns; smoke you can see from orbit.

systems.name: Lucent
systems.description: The money-world of the Core: a thousand banks and a sky of courier lights.

systems.name: Meridian Exchange
systems.description: Where the Reach's prices are set, and where they are argued about.

systems.name: Pallas Reach
systems.description: Gas-skimmers and a bourse that trades in fuel futures.

systems.name: Lanternfall
systems.description: A lighthouse-world on the long lane south; every ship that passes owes it a lamp.

systems.name: Saltmere
systems.description: Salt-farms, wide skies, and a people who have never much cared who ruled the Core.

systems.name: Harrow Deep
systems.description: A deep-belt mining world where the lanes thin and the law thins with them.

systems.name: Cinderfall
systems.description: Ash plains under a red sun; the houses here are young and hungry.

systems.name: Last Harbour
systems.description: The last safe water before the Verge proper. Smugglers call it home.

systems.name: The Gallows
systems.description: A prison-world once, a pirate haven now. No house has held it in living memory.

systems.name: Hollow Reach
systems.description: Ice and a listening post that stopped listening a generation ago.

systems.name: Wintermoor
systems.description: Hard winters, hard people, and a knightly house that answers to no count.

systems.name: Brackwater
systems.description: Fishing fleets, fog, and a grudge against every tithe ever levied.

systems.name: Sorrow
systems.description: Named by the first survey and never renamed. The richest belt in the Reach, and the loneliest.
